cards.name: Anti-Aircraft Flower
cards.officialText: By tributing 1 Insect-Type monster on your side of the field, inflict 800 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

cards.name: Arcane Archer of the Forest
cards.officialText: While there is a Plant-Type monster on your side of the field, this card cannot be attacked. By tributing 1 Plant-Type monster on your side of the field, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.
cards.firstTcgSet: Ancient Sanctuary (AST-DE029 in the official German database)

rulesSources.rule: A monster may be Tributed face-up or face-down unless the card text specifies otherwise.
The official German card text specifies a Plant monster face-up on the controller's field for the continuous protection condition.

behavior: maps all four physical seats to two shared teams while retaining physical owner seat separately from controller team
reads monster Race from engine metadata, with explicit source Race mapping for the two not-yet-admitted source cards
permits face-up or face-down monsters for typed Tribute costs, consistent with the general Tribute rule unless card text specifies face-up
routes Tribute destination to the physical-owner team Graveyard
routes Anti-Aircraft Flower's 800 damage to the opposing controller team
captures Arcane Archer's exact target UID at activation and rechecks the same physical identity at resolution
does not replace a target that leaves before resolution; the Tribute remains paid in the returned plan
counts only face-up Plants for Arcane Archer's continuous attack protection
returns only a boolean/reason for public attack restriction; private UIDs remain in server-side plans
adds action-ID idempotency without introducing a once-per-turn restriction absent from card text
returns read-only plans; caller must atomically commit Tribute movement, damage/destruction and the action ledger

groups: Anti-Aircraft Flower exact 800 damage with face-down Insect Tribute
no artificial once-per-turn restriction and action retry idempotency
Arcane Archer face-down Plant Tribute, Trap and separate Field Zone targets
target departure and physical identity replacement
face-up Plant-based attack protection and face-down Plant exclusion
team ownership, active physical representative and private identity checks

limits: The adapter does not register either effect in the central resolver or Discord command handler.
The returned plan is not a persisted transaction; the caller must atomically commit all physical movements and LP/destruction changes.
The adapter filters face-down monsters only from Arcane Archer's continuous Plant-presence protection; face-down monsters remain eligible for typed Tribute costs.
Effective monster Race changes are not currently projected by TagDuel metadata; printed Races and the two source Races are mapped.
Anti-Aircraft Flower and Arcane Archer remain outside the certified/playable catalog until separate admission and resolver integration.
